claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: GR-144053 is a GPIIb/IIIa (ITGA2B/ITGB3) integrin antagonist with no plausible cytotoxic mechanism against cancer cell lines at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive.
